depiction_rules.notes: A living adult human ruler. Keep his anatomy ordinary and two-armed; menace comes from expression, posture, and restrained shadow rather than bodily distortion.

visual_bible.face: strong features and stern brows; avoid caricature
visual_bible.hair: dark hair, simply tied or covered by restrained royal headwear
visual_bible.clothing: muted maroon and ochre royal garments with painted, non-metallic ornament
visual_bible.continuity_markers: restrained crown or headcloth; no modern details

never: no graphic violence or visible injury
no extra limbs, fangs, or monstrous anatomy
no glossy skin, metallic gold, or photorealistic rendering
note: Provisional minimal chapter contract for D039 scenes; not a separately approved character sheet.
